generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Total value of civl engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Bidder should have valid Class-3 and above Registered Electrical Contractor License issued from Public Work Department or Inspectorate of Electricity
The bidder should submit the GST/PAN Registration Certificate

Tenderer should submit annual turnover certificate having not less than average turnover of Rs 3.95 Lakhs in any two years during last five years i.e. 2021-22 to 2025-26 The turn over certificate should be mandatorily certified from chartered accountant and mention UDIN number is compulsory, otherwise it will be subjected to rejection

The Tenderer should have at least executed and satisfactorily completed as prime contractor, at least one Similar Electrical work in any Govt. Agency/ULBs/PSU for amount not less than Rs.1.975 Lakhs in Last Five Years i.e., 2021-22, TO 2025-26. NOTE The work done certificate submitted should be signed not less than the rank of Executive Engineer/Equivalent grade officer and also mention the E-procurement indent number
bidder has to submitt ongoing and existing works

itemList.description: Work of replacement of faulty control components and modification and rewiring of soft starter panel upto 1250KW/ 6KV motor as specified below. a. Disconnecting the power cables and control cables. b. Removal of faulty control components and cable disconnections. c. Supply and fixing Auxiliary contactors, upto 110Volt DC coil Supply with 2 NO, 2NC. d. Supply and fixing of Electronic Timers, 24 Volt AC Range 0 to 30 seconds. e. Supply and fixing of MCBs, 2 pole, 10A. f. Supply and fixing of suitable color LED indication Bulbs and reset Push Buttons Red in color. g. Supply and fixing of temperature Scanner. Along with RTDs 3.5 Mtr Each. h. The necessary tapping/drilling work has to be done for fixing the above components and rewiring to be done etc., i. Testing the soft starter with above supplied components. j. Commissioning the soft starter and handing over the system to department.
Current Transformer 33 kv class CT With 0.2 accurancy class 400-200 1-1A for lines

Supply of IEC standard Medium Voltage, 400A Vacuum Contactor (indoor), 3 Pole, AC-4 Utilization Category with 110V DC Coil and Auxiliary Contactors and other allied accessories complete suitable for motor control application strictly conforming to the specifications and requirements of IEC 60470. Chopping current 0.5A, maintenance free, long electrical & mechanical life, and remote control, capable of integration in computerized control. Contactor must be fitted with operating mechanism with electrical latching, mechanical open/close signaling, six pairs of open/close signaling contacts (six break contacts plus six make contacts), basic cabling with socket, cabled plug with 3m long cord etc. complete. Rated Voltage, Ur = 12kV Rated Insulation Withstand Voltage at 50 Hz, Ud = 42kV Rated Insulation Impulse Withstand Voltage, Up = 75kVp Rated Frequency, fr = 50Hz Rated Service Current, Ie = 400A Short-Time Withstand Current for 1 sec, Ik = 6kA , Short-Time Withstand Current for 30 sec, Ik = 2.5kA Rated Peak Current, Ip = 15kAp Rated Short Circuit Time, tk = 1s , Rated Max. Over current Withstand for 1/2 period= 55kAp
